files.body:
package main

import "gno.land/r/gnops/valopers"

func main(cur realm) {
    newDescription := `EmberStake is a professional staking infrastructure operator focused on performance, automation, and ecosystem contribution.

Validator: EmberStake
Networks: We currently operate production validators on multiple high-profile mainnets, including Monad, Namada (genesis validator), and Taiko (Proposer). Our total Assets Under Management (AuM) across networks is approximately $5 million.

Digital Presence: Website https://emberstake.xyz/, GitHub https://github.com/EmberStake, X https://x.com/Ember_Stake. Discord: @4rash.
Contact: contact@emberstake.xyz | Telegram: @verrekt.

Why gno.land: We have been early members of the gno.land ecosystem and are excited to finally contribute meaningfully. The combination of Tendermint 2.0, the Gno language, and on-chain readable source code philosophy represents a unique approach. We are drawn to the contribution-first model.

Contributions: Automated containerized validator deployments (Docker/K8s), guides & documentation, public RPC/WS endpoints, monitoring tooling, and exploring GnoVM application development.`

    valopers.UpdateDescription(cross(cur), "g1fzjcyrhv7rtrpwhsd0mhl9n7ahxm0v34p9w5kn", newDescription)
}
